subject: Probe kit conditional handover & revocation plan
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novara.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novara.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: conditional handover for probe kit + MAP

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profiles looked promising. Novara is ready to run a focused evaluation against our classifier suite, but we need clarity on an exchange approach for a small probe dataset and prompt pack. Our legal and security teams asked for a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that covers:

- Limited usage: evaluation-only, no retraining, no redistribution.
- Ephemeral hosting: sandbox-only, access window of 30 days.
- Technical controls: watermarked samples, read-only S3, token-limited API keys.
- Evidence: deletion certification and access logs after takedown.

We can provide the dataset as an encrypted S3 bundle and a short prompt pack ( ~250 records ). Novara is open to an escrow deposit or staged escrow to mitigate IP exposure while we test. Can Redwood propose a MAP and a timeline that includes takedown and certification steps?

Attaching a short probe-kit checklist and our baseline security questionnaire.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Head of ML Ops
Novara AI
attachments: probe-kit-checklist.xlsx, novara-security-questionnaire.pdf
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novara.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: conditional handover for probe kit + MAP

Ellen — appreciate the clear ask. We can support a constrained evaluation flow that matches what you described. High level proposal:

1) Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft (we'll attach v2):
   - Purpose: evaluation-only access for 30 days.
   - Usage constraints: no retraining, no public redistribution, input/outputs logged and retained for 90 days for audit.
   - Escrow: we propose a probationary escrow (20% release on ingest; remainder released after certified takedown) — alternative: a letter of credit.
2) Technical controls:
   - Ephemeral sandbox in your preferred region (us-west) with read-only S3 mounting and token-limited API keys.
   - Watermarking: we support lightweight deterministic watermarking on returned snippets and a KV-only access path for raw tokens.
   - Auditability: we will capture per-request logs (query, model variant, latency, tokens) and provide an export after takedown.
3) Takedown & certification:
   - Job: automated takedown script + manual verification by Redwood security engineer.
   - Deliverable: signed deletion certificate and logs bundle within 5 business days of takedown.
4) Timeline suggestion:
   - Day 0: MAP + SOW signed, escrow instrument in place.
   - Day 2: Dataset ingest and sandbox provisioning.
   - Day 3–33: Evaluation window (30 days).
   - Day 34–38: Takedown, verification, certification.

I'm attaching a short MAP draft and the probe handoff checklist for your review (Novara items we added inline). If this looks good, Marissa from Partnerships will pick up the SOW and DocuSign flow.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
attachments: Novara-MAP-draft-v2.pdf, redwood-ephemeral-access-sla.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novara.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: conditional handover for probe kit + MAP

Thanks Logan / Ellen — looping in a couple procurement items to speed closure. A few clarifications from our side (short list):

- Escrow mechanics: can Novara accept a staged escrow via our legal partner (escrow agent) or do you prefer your internal instrument? We can provide the agent details (we've used them for similar MPA exchanges).
- Watermarking: can you confirm if Novara needs deterministic or probabilistic watermarking? Deterministic is easier to audit but may require us to mask some fields.
- Acceptance criteria: please confirm 3 success signals you want us to track (e.g., recall on labeled subset, latency under 200ms p95, and at least 5 edge-case prompt types).

Action items so we can finalize the MAP by Friday:
- Novara: confirm escrow instrument and watermarking preference (reply to this thread).
- Redwood: finalize SOW and DocuSign, prepare provisioning checklist.

We will also attach an internal statement of destruction template for your legal team to review.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Partnerships Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@novara.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: conditional handover for probe kit + MAP

Marissa / Logan — thanks. Novara confirms the following so we can proceed: 

- Escrow: we will use Redwood's escrow agent; Novara legal to execute the escrow instructions by EOD Monday.
- Watermarking: deterministic watermarking is acceptable. Please limit visible masking to PII fields only.
- Acceptance criteria: Novara requests the three signals you suggested (labeled recall, p95 latency under 200ms, prompt coverage for 5 edge types).

We agree to the proposed timeline. Two quick asks before ingest:
1) Please provide a sample deletion certificate template and exact log export format (CSV + JSON).
2) Can you enable a read-only API key scoped to 10k tokens/day for the initial window?

If you send the DocuSign link, I'll get the signers assigned.

Best,
Ellen Park
Head of ML Ops
Novara AI
attachments: signed-probe-intent.pdf (attached separately)
